fields.title: Nile Organics Olive Oil Soap
fields.description: Handcrafted natural olive oil soap made with pure Egyptian olive oil. Gently cleanses and nourishes the skin. Free from harsh chemicals and ideal for daily use.

fields.title: Cairo Glow Face Cream
fields.description: Lightweight face cream enriched with natural Egyptian herbs. Moisturizes deeply and restores skin radiance. Suitable for all skin types.

fields.title: Pharaoh Herbal Shampoo
fields.description: Natural herbal shampoo made with Egyptian herbs and oils. Strengthens hair, reduces breakage, and leaves a refreshing scent. Free from sulfates and parabens.

fields.title: Giza Beauty Argan Oil
fields.description: Pure Egyptian argan oil for skin, hair, and nails. Rich in antioxidants and essential fatty acids. Can be used for hydration, massage, or as a hair treatment.

fields.title: Lotus Spa Body Lotion
fields.description: Hydrating body lotion infused with natural Egyptian oils. Softens skin and provides long-lasting moisture. Suitable for daily use after shower or bath.

fields.title: Oasis Natural Lip Balm
fields.description: Moisturizing lip balm made from beeswax and Egyptian natural oils. Protects lips from dryness and cracking. Compact and ideal for daily carry.

fields.title: Delta Aloe Vera Gel
fields.description: Soothing aloe vera gel made with pure Egyptian aloe. Cools and hydrates skin after sun exposure or minor irritations. Suitable for all skin types.

fields.title: Luxor Facial Toner
fields.description: Refreshing facial toner made with Egyptian rose water and herbs. Helps tighten pores, balance skin, and reduce oiliness. Gentle formula suitable for daily use.

fields.title: Sands Herbal Body Scrub
fields.description: Exfoliating body scrub made with natural Egyptian herbs and salts. Removes dead skin cells and improves circulation. Leaves skin soft, smooth, and refreshed.

fields.title: Alex Essential Massage Oil
fields.description: Premium massage oil with natural Egyptian essential oils. Hydrates skin and relaxes muscles. Perfect for spa treatments or home use.
